content: Deibid Labi Ona Isileli Labenaa I Pakokovel
Deibid i tabwa kin Isileli gegewel elal ge wana logulogugui i waisi ge i sapu.
Seluwaiya natuna Yowab, iya tolohaveyan wali tohouwa. Ahilud natuna Yehosapat, iya kin wana logugui ana tomatahikan ge ana towasa.
Ahitub natuna Seidok, ge Abaiyada natuna Ahimelek,
heliya hi topowon. Selaiya iya toleleli.
Yehoiyada natuna Benaiya, iya boda Keleti ge boda Peleti wali tohouwa. Ge Deibid natunau heliya hi ola topowon.

footnotes.text: Abaiyada natuna Ahimelek Topapasikal enuna pana dimdim hi teli Ahimelek natuna Abaiyada. 1 Samuwela 22:16-23 nu kite.

Heliya nige topowon hot i oola, kaiwena heliya nige un Libai gamagaliliyau i oola. Nige ta aatena hauna kaba tuwalali hi ginol ge i ola topowon wali tuwalali. Topapasikal enuna hi teli heliya Deibid wana totuwalali bwabwatal enuna. He tabam Hibilu vilanina ya ana sapu etega i ola to.
